```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(GenomicRanges)
  library(GenomeInfoDb)
  library(rtracklayer)
  library(S4Vectors)
  library(IRanges)
  library(dplyr)
  library(ggplot2)
})

set.seed(123)
```


```{r}
data_dir <- if (basename(getwd()) == "week10") "." else "week10"

peak_file <- file.path(data_dir, "GATA2_K562_peaks.bed.gz")
re2g_file <- file.path(data_dir, "K562_re2g_thresholded_links.bed.gz")
promoter_file <- file.path(data_dir, "promoters.rds")

if (!file.exists(peak_file)) {
  download.file(
    "https://www.encodeproject.org/files/ENCFF772OKO/@@download/ENCFF772OKO.bed.gz",
    destfile = peak_file,
    mode = "wb"
  )
}

if (!file.exists(re2g_file)) {
  download.file(
    "https://www.encodeproject.org/files/ENCFF600XIR/@@download/ENCFF600XIR.bed.gz",
    destfile = re2g_file,
    mode = "wb"
  )
}

if (!file.exists(promoter_file)) {
  download.file(
    "https://ethz-ins.org/content/hgEns104.promoters.rds",
    destfile = promoter_file,
    mode = "wb"
  )
}
```

```{r}
peak_tbl <- read.delim(gzfile(peak_file), header = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

colnames(peak_tbl)[1:10] <- c(
  "chrom", "start", "end", "name", "score", "strand",
  "signalValue", "pValue", "qValue", "peak"
)

peaks <- GRanges(
  seqnames = peak_tbl$chrom,
  ranges = IRanges(start = peak_tbl$start + 1, end = peak_tbl$end),
  strand = "*",
  name = peak_tbl$name,
  score = peak_tbl$score,
  signalValue = peak_tbl$signalValue,
  pValue = peak_tbl$pValue,
  qValue = peak_tbl$qValue,
  peak = peak_tbl$peak
)

suppressWarnings(seqlevelsStyle(peaks) <- "UCSC")
peaks <- keepStandardChromosomes(peaks, pruning.mode = "coarse")
peaks$peak_id <- seq_along(peaks)

peaks
```
```{r}
re2g_tbl <- read.delim(gzfile(re2g_file), header = TRUE, check.names = FALSE)

names(re2g_tbl)
head(re2g_tbl)
```


```{r}
find_col <- function(nms, choices, pattern = NULL) {
  hit <- match(tolower(choices), tolower(nms), nomatch = 0)
  if (any(hit > 0)) return(nms[hit[hit > 0][1]])

  if (!is.null(pattern)) {
    hit <- grep(pattern, nms, ignore.case = TRUE, value = TRUE)
    if (length(hit) > 0) return(hit[1])
  }

  NA_character_
}

nms <- names(re2g_tbl)

chr_col <- find_col(nms, c("chr", "chrom", "chromosome"))
start_col <- find_col(nms, c("start", "chromStart"))
end_col <- find_col(nms, c("end", "chromEnd"))
gene_col <- find_col(nms, c("TargetGene", "target_gene", "gene", "gene_name"), pattern = "TargetGene|gene")

if (is.na(chr_col)) chr_col <- nms[1]
if (is.na(start_col)) start_col <- nms[2]
if (is.na(end_col)) end_col <- nms[3]

stopifnot(!is.na(gene_col))

re2g <- GRanges(
  seqnames = re2g_tbl[[chr_col]],
  ranges = IRanges(
    start = as.integer(re2g_tbl[[start_col]]) + 1,
    end = as.integer(re2g_tbl[[end_col]])
  ),
  target_gene = re2g_tbl[[gene_col]]
)

suppressWarnings(seqlevelsStyle(re2g) <- "UCSC")
re2g <- keepStandardChromosomes(re2g, pruning.mode = "coarse")
re2g <- re2g[!is.na(re2g$target_gene) & re2g$target_gene != ""]

re2g
```

```{r}
ov <- findOverlaps(peaks, re2g, ignore.strand = TRUE)

peak_targets <- data.frame(
  peak_id = peaks$peak_id[queryHits(ov)],
  target_gene = re2g$target_gene[subjectHits(ov)]
) |>
  distinct()

linked_peak_ids <- unique(peak_targets$peak_id)
linked_peaks <- peaks[peaks$peak_id %in% linked_peak_ids]

length(peaks)
length(linked_peaks)
head(peak_targets)
```

```{r}
promoters <- readRDS(promoter_file)
suppressWarnings(seqlevelsStyle(promoters) <- "UCSC")
promoters <- keepStandardChromosomes(promoters, pruning.mode = "coarse")
promoters <- promoters[!is.na(promoters$gene_name) & promoters$gene_name != ""]

tss_position <- ifelse(
  as.character(strand(promoters)) == "+",
  start(promoters) + 100,
  end(promoters) - 100
)

tss <- GRanges(
  seqnames = seqnames(promoters),
  ranges = IRanges(tss_position, width = 1),
  strand = strand(promoters),
  gene_name = promoters$gene_name
)

tss <- tss[!duplicated(paste(seqnames(tss), start(tss), strand(tss), tss$gene_name))]

tss
```

```{r}
nearest_hit <- distanceToNearest(peaks, tss, ignore.strand = TRUE)

nearest_tbl <- data.frame(
  peak_id = peaks$peak_id[queryHits(nearest_hit)],
  nearest_gene = tss$gene_name[subjectHits(nearest_hit)],
  nearest_tss_distance = mcols(nearest_hit)$distance
)

head(nearest_tbl)
```

```{r}
peak_info <- data.frame(
  peak_id = peaks$peak_id,
  peak_chr = as.character(seqnames(peaks)),
  peak_center = start(peaks) + floor((width(peaks) - 1) / 2)
)

tss_info <- data.frame(
  gene_name = tss$gene_name,
  peak_chr = as.character(seqnames(tss)),
  target_tss = start(tss),
  target_strand = as.character(strand(tss))
) |>
  distinct()

analysis_tbl <- peak_targets |>
  mutate(link_id = row_number()) |>
  left_join(peak_info, by = "peak_id") |>
  inner_join(
    tss_info,
    by = c("target_gene" = "gene_name", "peak_chr"),
    relationship = "many-to-many"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    signed_distance = ifelse(
      target_strand == "+",
      peak_center - target_tss,
      target_tss - peak_center
    ),
    target_distance = abs(signed_distance),
    direction = ifelse(signed_distance < 0, "upstream", "downstream")
  ) |>
  group_by(link_id) |>
  slice_min(target_distance, n = 1, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  ungroup() |>
  left_join(nearest_tbl, by = "peak_id") |>
  select(
    peak_id, target_gene, target_tss, target_strand,
    signed_distance, target_distance, direction,
    nearest_gene, nearest_tss_distance
  )

head(analysis_tbl)
```


```{r}
summary_tbl <- analysis_tbl |>
  group_by(direction) |>
  summarise(
    n_peak_target_links = n(),
    n_unique_peaks = n_distinct(peak_id),
    proportion_target_is_nearest_gene = mean(target_gene == nearest_gene),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

summary_tbl
```

```{r}
ggplot(analysis_tbl, aes(target_distance / 1000)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ direction, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Distance from GATA2 peak center to predicted target TSS (kb)",
    y = "Number of peak-target links",
    title = "Distances between GATA2 peaks and predicted rE2G target genes"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
ggplot(analysis_tbl, aes(target_distance / 1000, y = after_stat(count + 1))) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ direction, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    x = "Distance from GATA2 peak center to predicted target TSS (kb)",
    y = "Number of peak-target links + 1 (log10 scale)",
    title = "Distances between GATA2 peaks and predicted rE2G target genes"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
ggplot(analysis_tbl, aes((target_distance + 1) / 1000, y = after_stat(count + 1))) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 60, fill = "steelblue", color = "white") +
  facet_wrap(~ direction, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    x = "Distance from GATA2 peak center to predicted target TSS + 1 bp (kb, log10 scale)",
    y = "Number of peak-target links + 1 (log10 scale)",
    title = "Distances between GATA2 peaks and predicted rE2G target genes"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
ggplot(summary_tbl, aes(direction, proportion_target_is_nearest_gene)) +
  geom_col(fill = "darkorange") +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Proportion",
    title = "Predicted target is also the nearest gene"
  ) +
  theme_classic()
```

## Results

```{r results-paragraph, results='asis'}
upstream_prop <- summary_tbl$proportion_target_is_nearest_gene[
  summary_tbl$direction == "upstream"
]

downstream_prop <- summary_tbl$proportion_target_is_nearest_gene[
  summary_tbl$direction == "downstream"
]

median_upstream <- median(
  analysis_tbl$target_distance[analysis_tbl$direction == "upstream"] / 1000,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

median_downstream <- median(
  analysis_tbl$target_distance[analysis_tbl$direction == "downstream"] / 1000,
  na.rm = TRUE
)

cat(
  "I used GATA2 ChIP-seq peaks from K562 cells and ENCODE-rE2G thresholded enhancer-gene predictions from the same cell type. Of ",
  length(peaks),
  " total GATA2 peaks, ",
  length(linked_peaks),
  " overlapped at least one rE2G element-gene link and were therefore kept for the comparison. ",
  "For upstream peak-target links, the predicted rE2G target was also the nearest TSS gene in ",
  round(100 * upstream_prop, 1),
  "% of cases. For downstream peak-target links, this was true in ",
  round(100 * downstream_prop, 1),
  "% of cases. The median distance between the peak center and the predicted target TSS was ",
  round(median_upstream, 1),
  " kb for upstream links and ",
  round(median_downstream, 1),
  " kb for downstream links. These results show that rE2G assigns many GATA2-bound regulatory regions to predicted target genes that are not necessarily the nearest gene in linear genomic distance.",
  sep = ""
)
```
